scripts.contracts:generate: uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run ruff format services/api scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run ruff format --check services/api scripts
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:py && pnpm format:check
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check services/api scripts
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: pnpm --filter @aijian/studio-web build && pnpm --filter @aijian/desktop build && node scripts/e2e/desktop-provider-smoke.mjs
scripts.evidence:provider-ui: pnpm --filter @aijian/studio-web build && pnpm --filter @aijian/desktop build && node scripts/e2e/desktop-provider-smoke.mjs
scripts.build:e2e:recovery-harness: pnpm exec tsc -p scripts/e2e/headless-harness.tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @aijian/studio-web exec vite build --config ../../scripts/e2e/headless-harness.vite.config.ts
scripts.evidence:fake-timeline-recovery: pnpm --filter @aijian/studio-web build && pnpm --filter @aijian/desktop build && pnpm build:e2e:recovery-harness && node scripts/e2e/electron-fake-timeline-headless-recovery.mjs
scripts.evidence:proposal-recovery: pnpm --filter @aijian/studio-web build && pnpm --filter @aijian/desktop build && pnpm build:e2e:recovery-harness && node scripts/e2e/electron-proposal-headless-recovery.mjs
scripts.test:py: uv run pytest --cov=aijian_api --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=json:coverage-python.json && uv run python scripts/check_python_coverage.py coverage-python.json
scripts.preview:workbench: pnpm --filter @aijian/studio-web build && pnpm --filter @aijian/desktop build && node scripts/workbench-preview.mjs
